idea-plugin.name: Agents Deck: Linear
idea-plugin.description:
Puts your Linear issues behind the # completion in Agents Deck.

  • # in chat — search your workspace by title, or type ENG-123 outright; the issue's title and description travel with the prompt.
  • Links in agent output — ENG-123 opens the issue, for the team keys your workspace actually has.
  • Settings › Connections › Integrations › Linear — which key is in force and who it belongs to.

Authentication is a Linear personal API key read from LINEAR_API_KEY in your environment, or from the env block of a configured stdio MCP server. No browser sign-in, and nothing is stored by this plugin. With no key set, it contributes nothing at all — the chat is exactly the chat Agents Deck ships.
